In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

_crawl.about: Henry Schein, Inc. (Nasdaq: HSIC) is a products, services, and technology platforms company for healthcare customers. With more than 25,000 Team Schein Members worldwide, the Company's network of trusted advisors provides more than 1 million customers globally with more than 300 valued solutions that help improve operational success and clinical outcomes. Our Business, Clinical, Technology, and Supply Chain solutions help office-based dental and medical practitioners work more efficiently so they can provide quality care more effectively. These solutions also support dental laboratories, government and institutional healthcare clinics, as well as other alternate care sites. Henry Schein operates through a centralized and automated distribution network, with a selection of more than 300,000 branded products and Henry Schein corporate brand products in our distribution centers. A FORTUNE 500 Company and a member of the S&P 500® index, Henry Schein is headquartered in Melville, N.Y., and has operations or affiliates in 34 countries and territories. The Company's sales reached $13.2 billion in 2025, and have grown at a compound annual rate of approximately 11.0 percent since Henry Schein became a public company in 1995.

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

## About the journal

AsiaIntervention is the official journal of the Asian-Pacific Society of Interventional Cardiology
([APSIC][18]) and the Interventional Cardiology Foundation of India (ICFI).
It is an international, English language, peer-reviewed journal whose aim is to create a forum of
high quality research and education in the field of percutaneous and surgical cardiovascular
interventions.
It is released in an online format three times a year and twice in print.
AsiaIntervention has applied for indexation in Science Citation Index® (ISI), SciVerse Scopus,
MEDLINE®/PubMed®.
[[Subscribe newsletter]][19]

## Volume 12, Number 1, March 2026

[[AsiaIntervention - New Issue March 2026]][20]

This issue of AsiaIntervention opens with original research on the use of sirolimus vs paclitaxel in
DCBs; continues with the PICCOLETO VI study; and includes original research on pulmonary artery
denervation for isolated post-capillary pulmonary hypertension; and excimer laser coronary
atherectomy for complex PCI; this issue’s Flashlights review a jailed DCB technique for
bifurcations; 3D OCT-guided single-string culotte bifurcation stenting; a surprising discovery in
LAD ISR; double-balloon tricuspid valvotomy; real-time IVUS-guided wiring in SCAD; and more…

Developing and providing innovative interventional medical devices to patients to improve their
health and quality of life

## Innovative interventional solutions addressing neurovascular and peripheral diseases

Headquartered in Singapore, the Hemo Group has built a suite of innovative interventional medical
devices targeting neuro-vascular diseases. Our comprehensive portfolio of neuro-interventional
medical devices covers the ischemic stroke, hemorrhagic stroke and neuro access fields. We also
conduct advanced R&D in US, and have introduced our products internationally across Europe, Asia and
Middle East.

Other than being a top notch neuro medical device manufacturer with **CE MDR**, **EN ISO 13485**,
Certified Class 10K Cleanroom, we also provide the following services:
* OEM for medical devices
* [Regulatory and Market Access partnership strategic service for medical device companies desiring
  to venture into different markets][28]

Contact us at [enquire@hemocorp.com][29] for our services.

## Our Company's Devices

### Mechanical Thrombectomy Devices


Hemo's Mechanical Thrombectomy Devices offers neuro-interventionalists in a differentiated tool for
the treatment of acute ischemic stroke.

Our Mechanical Thrombectomy Devices consist of CE MDR approved AsprAX Aspiration Catheter and
CerebrAX Stent Retriever System.

Click [here][30] to find out more.

### Access Devices


Our Company's Access Devices provides access for other neuro interventional devices in the treatment
of acute ischemic stroke, intracranial atherosclerosis and hemorrhagic stroke .

Our Access Devices consist of Intermediate Catheter, Balloon Guiding Catheter, and Micro Catheter.

Click [here][31] to find out more.
[FocuStar-02]

### Dilation Devices


Our Company's Dilation Device offers neuro-interventionalists in a differentiated tool for the
treatment of intracranial stenosis.

Our Dilation Device Consist of Balloon Dilation Catheter and Neuro Dilation Catheter (OTW).

Click [here][32] to find out more.

## Resources

### [
### Interventional Treatment for Ischemic Stroke: A Game-Changer in Patient Outcomes
### ][33]


Ischemic stroke is a leading cause of disability and death worldwide, characterized by the sudden
loss of blood flow to a part of the brain due to a clot obstructing a blood vessel. Traditional
treatments have focused on clot-dissolving medications, but these are time-sensitive and not always
effective. Recent advancements in interventional treatment, particularly mechanical thrombectomy,
have revolutionized the management of ischemic stroke, offering new hope to patients who might
otherwise face severe disability or death.

Click [here][34] to find out more.

### [ Recognizing Stroke Symptoms and Immediate Actions to Take Introduction ][35]


Strokes are a leading cause of death and disability worldwide. As such, recognize stroke symptoms
early and acting quickly can save lives and significantly reduce the impact of a stroke. This
article aims to educate the public on how to identify stroke symptoms and the immediate actions that
should be taken.

Click [here][36] to find out more.

### [ Understanding the Differences Between Ischemic and Hemorrhagic Strokes ][37]


Strokes rank among the top causes of disability and death globally, highlighting the importance of
understanding stroke types and their impact on the brain. The two main types, ischemic stroke and
hemorrhagic stroke, differ in causes, symptoms, and treatment approaches. This article compares
ischemic and hemorrhagic strokes to help you recognize stroke symptoms and the need for immediate
medical intervention.

Click [here][38] to find out more.

#### Interventional Radiology & Endovasculat Surgery

Interventional-Radiology.org and Endovascular.biz are educational platforms dedicated to sharing
real-world experience in interventional radiology and endovascular surgery. Through a carefully
curated collection of cases, we explore procedural techniques, technical decision-making,
problem-solving strategies, and clinical outcomes across a wide range of vascular and non-vascular
interventions.


The cases presented reflect individual approaches tailored to specific anatomical, pathological, and
clinical circumstances. They are intended as educational examples rather than prescriptive guidance,
recognising that multiple treatment strategies may be equally appropriate in contemporary practice.


While we showcase complex and challenging interventions, we also highlight routine cases that offer
valuable learning opportunities or particularly rewarding outcomes. Our goal is to support
continuous learning and professional development for clinicians at every stage of their career.

## Learn more about some common conditions that may occur

Scroll to learn more about the conditions

[Smiling lady leaning against building]

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

[Cataracts][17] occur when the normally clear lens of the eye becomes cloudy. As aging occurs,
protein from the lens clumps together, causing blurring, clouding, and discoloration of the lens.
Cataracts are the #1 cause of preventable blindness.¹

## Learn more about some common conditions that may occur

Scroll to learn more about the conditions

[Smiling lady leaning against building]

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

[Cataracts][17] occur when the normally clear lens of the eye becomes cloudy. As aging occurs,
protein from the lens clumps together, causing blurring, clouding, and discoloration of the lens.
Cataracts are the #1 cause of preventable blindness.¹

# Welcome to Northeast Georgia Physicians Group

**Northeast Georgia Physicians Group (NGPG)** brings together over 700 talented physicians,
physician assistants, nurse practitioners, midwives and other clinical staff at more than 50
locations across North Georgia. As the state’s sixth-largest physician group, we always have a
practice nearby to offer you expert care in more than 40 specialties.

NGPG is affiliated with [Northeast Georgia Health System (NGHS)][60], a non-profit which serves more
than 1 million people in 19 counties across the region. As part of NGHS, patients of NGPG have a
direct connection to Northeast Georgia Medical Center’s seven hospitals in Gainesville, Braselton,
Winder, Dahlonega and Demorest.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.

segments, routes to market, and opportunities that matter most-helping organizations sharpen their
strategy and unlock sustainable, high-quality growth.

Granular understanding of how customers discover, select, purchase and use products and services
across channels. We identify which needs are under served and which features or propositions

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.

[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on

## About the journal

AsiaIntervention is the official journal of the Asian-Pacific Society of Interventional Cardiology
([APSIC][18]) and the Interventional Cardiology Foundation of India (ICFI).
It is an international, English language, peer-reviewed journal whose aim is to create a forum of
high quality research and education in the field of percutaneous and surgical cardiovascular
interventions.
It is released in an online format three times a year and twice in print.
AsiaIntervention has applied for indexation in Science Citation Index® (ISI), SciVerse Scopus,
MEDLINE®/PubMed®.
[[Subscribe newsletter]][19]

## Volume 12, Number 1, March 2026

[[AsiaIntervention - New Issue March 2026]][20]

This issue of AsiaIntervention opens with original research on the use of sirolimus vs paclitaxel in
DCBs; continues with the PICCOLETO VI study; and includes original research on pulmonary artery
denervation for isolated post-capillary pulmonary hypertension; and excimer laser coronary
atherectomy for complex PCI; this issue’s Flashlights review a jailed DCB technique for
bifurcations; 3D OCT-guided single-string culotte bifurcation stenting; a surprising discovery in
LAD ISR; double-balloon tricuspid valvotomy; real-time IVUS-guided wiring in SCAD; and more…

 

[Editorial][21]
[Drug-coated balloons revisited – paclitaxel or sirolimus; PICCOLETO VI study; pulmonary artery
denervation − an evolving method of treating heart failure with preserved ejection fraction; use of
excimer laser for complex PCI; and several educative Flashlights][22]

## About the journal

AsiaIntervention is the official journal of the Asian-Pacific Society of Interventional Cardiology
([APSIC][18]) and the Interventional Cardiology Foundation of India (ICFI).
It is an international, English language, peer-reviewed journal whose aim is to create a forum of
high quality research and education in the field of percutaneous and surgical cardiovascular
interventions.
It is released in an online format three times a year and twice in print.
AsiaIntervention has applied for indexation in Science Citation Index® (ISI), SciVerse Scopus,
MEDLINE®/PubMed®.
[[Subscribe newsletter]][19]

## Volume 12, Number 1, March 2026

[[AsiaIntervention - New Issue March 2026]][20]

This issue of AsiaIntervention opens with original research on the use of sirolimus vs paclitaxel in
DCBs; continues with the PICCOLETO VI study; and includes original research on pulmonary artery
denervation for isolated post-capillary pulmonary hypertension; and excimer laser coronary
atherectomy for complex PCI; this issue’s Flashlights review a jailed DCB technique for
bifurcations; 3D OCT-guided single-string culotte bifurcation stenting; a surprising discovery in
LAD ISR; double-balloon tricuspid valvotomy; real-time IVUS-guided wiring in SCAD; and more…

# See what your competitors

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types
  CaptureWe monitor the unintentional data trails companies leave behind — job descriptions
  revealing technical debt, API documentation exposing new features, employee posts leaking project
  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.

  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become

  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.

  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,

  move before it's made, not after the press release.

The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

## Innovative interventional solutions addressing neurovascular and peripheral diseases

Headquartered in Singapore, the Hemo Group has built a suite of innovative interventional medical
devices targeting neuro-vascular diseases. Our comprehensive portfolio of neuro-interventional
medical devices covers the ischemic stroke, hemorrhagic stroke and neuro access fields. We also
conduct advanced R&D in US, and have introduced our products internationally across Europe, Asia and
Middle East.

Other than being a top notch neuro medical device manufacturer with **CE MDR**, **EN ISO 13485**,
Certified Class 10K Cleanroom, we also provide the following services:
* OEM for medical devices
* [Regulatory and Market Access partnership strategic service for medical device companies desiring
  to venture into different markets][28]

Contact us at [enquire@hemocorp.com][29] for our services.

## Our Company's Devices

### Mechanical Thrombectomy Devices


Hemo's Mechanical Thrombectomy Devices offers neuro-interventionalists in a differentiated tool for
the treatment of acute ischemic stroke.

Our Mechanical Thrombectomy Devices consist of CE MDR approved AsprAX Aspiration Catheter and
CerebrAX Stent Retriever System.

Click [here][30] to find out more.

### Access Devices


Our Company's Access Devices provides access for other neuro interventional devices in the treatment
of acute ischemic stroke, intracranial atherosclerosis and hemorrhagic stroke .

Our Access Devices consist of Intermediate Catheter, Balloon Guiding Catheter, and Micro Catheter.

Click [here][31] to find out more.
[FocuStar-02]

### Dilation Devices


Our Company's Dilation Device offers neuro-interventionalists in a differentiated tool for the
treatment of intracranial stenosis.

Our Dilation Device Consist of Balloon Dilation Catheter and Neuro Dilation Catheter (OTW).

Click [here][32] to find out more.

### [
### Interventional Treatment for Ischemic Stroke: A Game-Changer in Patient Outcomes
### ][33]


Ischemic stroke is a leading cause of disability and death worldwide, characterized by the sudden
loss of blood flow to a part of the brain due to a clot obstructing a blood vessel. Traditional
treatments have focused on clot-dissolving medications, but these are time-sensitive and not always
effective. Recent advancements in interventional treatment, particularly mechanical thrombectomy,
have revolutionized the management of ischemic stroke, offering new hope to patients who might
otherwise face severe disability or death.

Click [here][34] to find out more.

### [ Recognizing Stroke Symptoms and Immediate Actions to Take Introduction ][35]


Strokes are a leading cause of death and disability worldwide. As such, recognize stroke symptoms
early and acting quickly can save lives and significantly reduce the impact of a stroke. This
article aims to educate the public on how to identify stroke symptoms and the immediate actions that
should be taken.

Click [here][36] to find out more.

### [ Understanding the Differences Between Ischemic and Hemorrhagic Strokes ][37]


Strokes rank among the top causes of disability and death globally, highlighting the importance of
understanding stroke types and their impact on the brain. The two main types, ischemic stroke and
hemorrhagic stroke, differ in causes, symptoms, and treatment approaches. This article compares
ischemic and hemorrhagic strokes to help you recognize stroke symptoms and the need for immediate
medical intervention.

Click [here][38] to find out more.

#### ABOUT US

#### Interventional Radiology & Endovasculat Surgery

Interventional-Radiology.org and Endovascular.biz are educational platforms dedicated to sharing
real-world experience in interventional radiology and endovascular surgery. Through a carefully
curated collection of cases, we explore procedural techniques, technical decision-making,
problem-solving strategies, and clinical outcomes across a wide range of vascular and non-vascular
interventions.


The cases presented reflect individual approaches tailored to specific anatomical, pathological, and
clinical circumstances. They are intended as educational examples rather than prescriptive guidance,
recognising that multiple treatment strategies may be equally appropriate in contemporary practice.


While we showcase complex and challenging interventions, we also highlight routine cases that offer
valuable learning opportunities or particularly rewarding outcomes. Our goal is to support
continuous learning and professional development for clinicians at every stage of their career.

#### ABOUT US

#### Interventional Radiology & Endovasculat Surgery

Interventional-Radiology.org and Endovascular.biz are educational platforms dedicated to sharing
real-world experience in interventional radiology and endovascular surgery. Through a carefully
curated collection of cases, we explore procedural techniques, technical decision-making,
problem-solving strategies, and clinical outcomes across a wide range of vascular and non-vascular
interventions.


The cases presented reflect individual approaches tailored to specific anatomical, pathological, and
clinical circumstances. They are intended as educational examples rather than prescriptive guidance,
recognising that multiple treatment strategies may be equally appropriate in contemporary practice.


While we showcase complex and challenging interventions, we also highlight routine cases that offer
valuable learning opportunities or particularly rewarding outcomes. Our goal is to support
continuous learning and professional development for clinicians at every stage of their career.

## Learn more about some common conditions that may occur

Scroll to learn more about the conditions

[Smiling lady leaning against building]

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

[Cataracts][17] occur when the normally clear lens of the eye becomes cloudy. As aging occurs,
protein from the lens clumps together, causing blurring, clouding, and discoloration of the lens.
Cataracts are the #1 cause of preventable blindness.¹

TheNNT Rating System
**The Green Rating**
Therapies rated green are the best you can get
**The Yellow Rating**
Therapies rated yellow require more studies OR therapies with equal efficacy.
**The Red Rating**
Red suggest that benefits and harms may be equal or equivocal.
**The Black Rating**
Therapies rated black have very clear harms without any benefit.

ACLS
